answers.basic: I enjoy shopping when I know what I'm looking for, especially if it's for badminton. I get tired of walking around shops without a clear idea. I can happily spend time comparing two rackets because the choice matters to me and I know what I want to feel in my hand.

questions.prompt: How often do you go shopping?

answers.basic: I buy groceries most weeks. For clothes or sports gear, I shop when I actually need to replace something. That usually means a quick supermarket trip for a few meals and a separate trip if my shoes start to wear out.

questions.prompt: Do you prefer online shopping or in-store shopping?

answers.basic: For things I already know, online shopping is easier. I prefer a physical shop when I want to try on shoes or feel the weight of a racket. I might reorder shuttlecocks online, but I'd want to feel how a new racket swings before I commit to it.

questions.prompt: Have you ever returned anything you bought online?

answers.basic: Yes, I sent back a piece of clothing once because the size was off. I usually check the measurements and reviews more carefully now. The sleeves were shorter than I'd expected, so I sent it back and compared the measurements with a shirt I already liked.
